argumentDescriptions.ActivateObjects.objects[].type: Object type: an ADT type code (either case), or a name standing for one (in brackets after it): CLAS/OC (class), INTF/OI (interface), PROG/P (program), PROG/I (include), FUGR/F (functiongroup), FUGR/FF (function, functionmodule, function_module, func), FUGR/I, DEVC/K (package), DDLS/DF (view), VIEW/DV (dbview), TABL/DT (table), TABL/DS (structure, stru), TTYP/DA, DOMA/DD (domain), DTEL/DE (dataelement), DCLS/DL, BDEF/BDO, DDLX/EX, SRVD/SRV, SRVB/SVB, DSFD/SCF, DSFI/SFI, XSLT/VT, FTG2/FT, AUTH, ENHO/XHH, ENHO/XHB, ENHS/XSB, PROG/PX, CLAS/OCX. One object alone may also be named function_group, ddl, data_element, behavior_definition, metadata_extension. PROG/PX is a program's text elements, or with parentName a function group's; CLAS/OCX is a class's text elements; each is activated together with its object when both are named. A name is written in lower case: view is a CDS view (DDLS/DF). A value in upper case is a code, a main type or a search name of the system's object types list first, so VIEW is the dictionary views (VIEW/DV); it is a name only when it is none of these (CLASS is class). A main type, the part of a code before its slash, stands for its code when exactly one listed code has it. In upper case, a search name of the system's object types list stands for the listed code its list item has (e.g. STRU for TABL/DS).
argumentDescriptions.ActivateObjects.preaudit: Request pre-audit before activation. Default: true. Sent as preauditRequested on both paths, single-object activation and group activation. With true a system may answer the objects still inactive and activate nothing; sending them again with false is the next call. These codes and kinds (either case) and names (lower case) take single-object activation: CLAS/OC, PROG/P, INTF/OI, FUGR/F, TABL/DT, TABL/DS, DDLS/DF, DOMA/DD, DTEL/DE, BDEF/BDO, DDLX/EX, function_group, ddl, data_element, behavior_definition, metadata_extension, class, program, functiongroup, interface, table, structure, domain, dataelement, view, stru. So does a main type or a search name standing for one of these codes; any other call is a group activation.

descriptions.ActivateObjects: Activates several ABAP repository objects of any type together in one activation, such as domains, data elements and tables at once.
descriptions.GetIncludesList: [read-only] Lists every include of an ABAP program or include, with the includes each one includes, down to the last. The object's type and name. The includes left unread are named. The object itself, its root and for each include it includes: its name and whether it includes itself again or was met before elsewhere. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. By default the run goes on after the call, and its result comes back under the run_handle the call gives; with background false the result comes back in the call.
descriptions.GetObjectVersionDiff: [read-only] Compares two versions of a class, program, CDS view or other source object, taken from its version history: the changes between their sources, whether they are identical and which source came back empty.
descriptions.GetObjectVersions: [read-only] Lists the version history of an ABAP class, program, interface, function module, table, structure, CDS view or other versioned object. The object's type and name. For each version: its ID, its author, when it was saved, the transport that produced it and the URI of its source.
descriptions.GetObjectVersionSource: [read-only] Reads the source of one version of an ABAP class, program, interface, function module, table, CDS view or other versioned object, from its version history. The reference of the version read and its source code.
descriptions.GetWhereUsed: [read-only] Finds where an ABAP class, function module, table or other repository object is used: every object that uses, calls or references it. How many references SAP counts. For each object that uses it, under its package: its type, its name, its URI when SAP lists it nameless and how it uses the object, where SAP tells it. Runs on an ABAP session of its own. By default the run goes on after the call, and its result comes back under the run_handle the call gives; with background false the result comes back in the call.

descriptions.HandlerDelete: Deletes the ABAP repository object of the type object_type names, or empties a class include under the class's lock. Whether SAP deleted the object, its name and SAP's message about it. object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*, transport_request), DOMAIN(domain_name*, transport_request), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*, transport_request), TABLE(table_name*, transport_request), STRUCTURE(structure_name*, transport_request), TABLE_TYPE(table_type_name*, transport_request), DDL(ddl_name*, transport_request), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*, transport_request), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*, transport_request), CLASS(class_name*, transport_request), CDS_UNIT_TEST(class_name*, transport_request), PROGRAM(program_name*, transport_request), INCLUDE(include_name*, transport_request), INTERFACE(interface_name*, transport_request), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*, transport_request), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name*, function_group_name*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(behavior_definition_name*, transport_request), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(behavior_implementation_name*, transport_request), METADATA_EXTENSION(metadata_extension_name*, transport_request), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request), UNIT_TEST(class_name*, lock_handle*, transport_request). descriptions.HandlerDeletionCheck: [read-only] Asks SAP whether the ABAP repository object of the type object_type names can be deleted. Whether SAP lets the object be deleted, its name and SAP's message about it. object_type and object_name required: PACKAGE, DOMAIN, DATA_ELEMENT, TABLE, STRUCTURE, TABLE_TYPE, DDL, SERVICE_DEFINITION, SERVICE_BINDING, CLASS, CDS_UNIT_TEST (its test class), PROGRAM, INCLUDE, INTERFACE, FUNCTION_GROUP, FUNCTION_MODULE (object_name GROUP|MODULE), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION, BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION, METADATA_EXTENSION.
descriptions.HandlerGet: [read-only] Reads one part of the ABAP repository object of the type object_type names, of the repository by ADT address, or of an activation run by its id. part source: reads the source of the object at the version asked: its source code and the version read. part metadata: reads the metadata of the object at the version asked, as its type keeps it. part urls: builds the Fiori preview URL of a published OData service binding, with its service and $metadata URLs: its service's live state, OData protocol, service, service definition, service version, entity sets, binding category, client, logon language, associations, service URL, service URL source, $metadata URL, annotation URL, preview URL, preview descriptor, notes, whether it is published, whether the system's HTTP origin is known, what the preview URL still needs and the failure of reading the system's client and language. part contents: lists the objects of one or more ABAP packages, with the objects of their subpackages when asked: for each object of the package or a subpackage, under its own package: its type, its name, its technical name where it differs, its URI when SAP lists it nameless and its description, with descriptions asked. part main_programs: finds the main programs of an ABAP include: each program that includes it, or the function group it belongs to: the include's name; for each main program: whether it is a program or a function group and its name. part draft: tells whether an ABAP class, interface, program, CDS view, table or other development object holds an unactivated change, and whose: whether the object holds an unactivated change of any user; for each part, its main source or metadata or a class include: its name, its state (active, the caller's change, another user's change or undetermined), when that change was last written, how many seconds ago and the ETags of its active, inactive and working versions. part object_structure: reads the structure of an ABAP repository object, such as a CDS view: its parts and their parts, down to the last level: each part of the object, such as an element, an association or an annotation, is named by its type and its name or description, at its depth. part node_structure: reads one level of the repository browser of a package, class, program or other repository object, at its root or the node asked: whether SAP could load the level and what an empty package level means; for each object: its name, type, description, technical name and ADT URI; for each child node: its type and node ID. part virtual_folders: reads the virtual folders that group ABAP repository objects by package, group, type and other facets, for a name pattern: SAP's data as it came. part activation_status: reads the status of an activation run by its id: the run's id, the part read, the run's status, finished, error, failed or its progress and its status as SAP gave it. part activation_results: reads the results of an activation run by its id: SAP's verdict and the messages the run produced: the run's id, the part read, whether SAP activated it, by the results' verdict, whether it was already active and its results as SAP gave them; for each message of the run: its severity, its text, the object it is about, the address of that object, the object and its part as SAP describes them, the source it names, its position there and SAP's message code. object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*; part contents: package_name* or package_names*), DOMAIN(domain_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*), TABLE(table_name*), STRUCTURE(structure_name*), TABLE_TYPE(table_type_name*), DDL(ddl_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*), CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*), PROGRAM(program_name*), INCLUDE(include_name*), INTERFACE(interface_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name* as GROUP|MODULE, or function_module_name* with function_group_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(behavior_definition_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(behavior_implementation_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(metadata_extension_name*), UNIT_TEST(run_id*), CDS_UNIT_TEST(run_id*), TRANSPORT(transport_number*), TABLE_SETTINGS(table_name*), PROGRAM_TEXT_ELEMENTS(program_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP_TEXT_ELEMENTS(function_group_name*), CLASS_TEXT_ELEMENTS(class_name*). Runs on an ABAP session of its own. By default the run goes on after the call, and its result comes back under the run_handle the call gives; with background false the result comes back in the call.

for each main program: whether it is a program or a function group and its name. part draft: tells whether an ABAP class, interface, program, CDS view, table or other development object holds an unactivated change, and whose: whether the object holds an unactivated change of any user; for each part, its main source or metadata or a class include: its name, its state (active, the caller's change, another user's change or undetermined), when that change was last written, how many seconds ago and the ETags of its active, inactive and working versions. part object_structure: reads the structure of an ABAP repository object, such as a CDS view: its parts and their parts, down to the last level: each part of the object, such as an element, an association or an annotation, is named by its type and its name or description, at its depth. part node_structure: reads one level of the repository browser of a package, class, program or other repository object, at its root or the node asked: whether SAP could load the level and what an empty package level means; for each object: its name, type, description, technical name and ADT URI; for each child node: its type and node ID. part virtual_folders: reads the virtual folders that group ABAP repository objects by package, group, type and other facets, for a name pattern: SAP's data as it came. part activation_status: reads the status of an activation run by its id: the run's id, the part read, the run's status, finished, error, failed or its progress and its status as SAP gave it. part activation_results: reads the results of an activation run by its id: SAP's verdict and the messages the run produced: the run's id, the part read, whether SAP activated it, by the results' verdict, whether it was already active and its results as SAP gave them; part contents: package_name* or package_names*), DOMAIN(domain_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*), TABLE(table_name*), STRUCTURE(structure_name*), TABLE_TYPE(table_type_name*), DDL(ddl_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*), CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*), PROGRAM(program_name*), INCLUDE(include_name*), INTERFACE(interface_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name* as GROUP|MODULE, or function_module_name* with function_group_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(behavior_definition_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(behavior_implementation_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(metadata_extension_name*), UNIT_TEST(run_id*), CDS_UNIT_TEST(run_id*), TRANSPORT(transport_number*), TABLE_SETTINGS(table_name*), PROGRAM_TEXT_ELEMENTS(program_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP_TEXT_ELEMENTS(function_group_name*), CLASS_TEXT_ELEMENTS(class_name*). argumentDescriptions.ActivateObjects.objects[].type: Object type: an ADT type code (either case), or a name standing for one (in brackets after it): CLAS/OC (class), INTF/OI (interface), FUGR/F (functiongroup), FUGR/FF (function, functionmodule, function_module, func), FUGR/I, DEVC/K (package), DDLS/DF (view), VIEW/DV (dbview), TABL/DT (table), TABL/DS (structure, stru), TTYP/DA, DOMA/DD (domain), DTEL/DE (dataelement), DCLS/DL, BDEF/BDO, DDLX/EX, SRVD/SRV, SRVB/SVB, DSFD/SCF, DSFI/SFI, XSLT/VT, AUTH, ENHO/XHH, ENHO/XHB, ENHS/XSB, PROG/PX, CLAS/OCX. One object alone may also be named function_group, ddl, data_element, behavior_definition, metadata_extension. PROG/PX is a program's text elements, or with parentName a function group's; CLAS/OCX is a class's text elements; each is activated together with its object when both are named. A name is written in lower case: view is a CDS view (DDLS/DF). A value in upper case is a code, a main type or a search name of the system's object types list first, so VIEW is the dictionary views (VIEW/DV); it is a name only when it is none of these (CLASS is class). A main type, the part of a code before its slash, stands for its code when exactly one listed code has it. In upper case, a search name of the system's object types list stands for the listed code its list item has (e.g. STRU for TABL/DS).
argumentDescriptions.ActivateObjects.preaudit: Request pre-audit before activation. Default: true. Sent as preauditRequested on both paths, single-object activation and group activation. With true a system may answer the objects still inactive and activate nothing; sending them again with false is the next call. These codes and kinds (either case) and names (lower case) take single-object activation: CLAS/OC, INTF/OI, FUGR/F, TABL/DT, TABL/DS, DDLS/DF, DOMA/DD, DTEL/DE, BDEF/BDO, DDLX/EX, function_group, ddl, data_element, behavior_definition, metadata_extension, class, functiongroup, interface, table, structure, domain, dataelement, view, stru. descriptions.GetIncludesList: [read-only] Lists every include of an ABAP program or include, with the includes each one includes, down to the last. The object's type and name. for each object: its name, type, description, technical name and ADT URI; for each child node: its type and node ID. part virtual_folders: reads the virtual folders that group ABAP repository objects by package, group, type and other facets, for a name pattern: SAP's data as it came. part activation_status: reads the status of an activation run by its id: the run's id, the part read, the run's status, finished, error, failed or its progress and its status as SAP gave it. part activation_results: reads the results of an activation run by its id: SAP's verdict and the messages the run produced: the run's id, the part read, whether SAP activated it, by the results' verdict, whether it was already active and its results as SAP gave them; for each message of the run: its severity, its text, the object it is about, the address of that object, the object and its part as SAP describes them, the source it names, its position there and SAP's message code. object_type required: PACKAGE(package_name*; part contents: package_name* or package_names*), DOMAIN(domain_name*), DATA_ELEMENT(data_element_name*), TABLE(table_name*), STRUCTURE(structure_name*), TABLE_TYPE(table_type_name*), DDL(ddl_name*), SERVICE_DEFINITION(service_definition_name*), SERVICE_BINDING(service_binding_name*), CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TEST_CLASS(class_name*), LOCAL_TYPES(class_name*), LOCAL_DEFINITIONS(class_name*), LOCAL_MACROS(class_name*), PROGRAM(program_name*), INCLUDE(include_name*), INTERFACE(interface_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP(function_group_name*), FUNCTION_MODULE(function_module_name* as GROUP|MODULE, or function_module_name* with function_group_name*), BEHAVIOR_DEFINITION(behavior_definition_name*), BEHAVIOR_IMPLEMENTATION(behavior_implementation_name*), METADATA_EXTENSION(metadata_extension_name*), UNIT_TEST(run_id*), CDS_UNIT_TEST(run_id*), TRANSPORT(transport_number*), TABLE_SETTINGS(table_name*), PROGRAM_TEXT_ELEMENTS(program_name*), FUNCTION_GROUP_TEXT_ELEMENTS(function_group_name*), CLASS_TEXT_ELEMENTS(class_name*).
